_comment: Optional. A reference card for whatever you and a clinician have actually agreed you take. It ships EMPTY on purpose. A supplement regimen is medical information about a specific person, no example set belongs in a public repository, and the dashboard simply hides the card when both lists are empty.
_caution: Nothing here is advice. Doses interact with medication, with each other, and with conditions this app knows nothing about. Fill this in from a conversation with a clinician who has seen your bloods, not from a search result and not from an agent.

_shape.name: What it is
_shape.detail: Dose, timing, food sources, anything you want to remember
